# MOCK-202: Add CSV export for order history

## Requirements
1. Add a "Export CSV" button on the Order History page.
2. Clicking it downloads a CSV of the currently filtered/visible orders (respecting
   the date-range filter already on the page).
3. CSV columns: Order ID, Date, Status, Total.

No other requirements. Do not add PDF export, email delivery, or scheduling in this
ticket — those are tracked separately in MOCK-203, MOCK-204.
